text:
Yegor Sharangovich has 10 points in 23 games for Calgary, a better scoring rate than last season, and after a two-point night against the Kings, Yahoo Sports carried his line: "I Still Need to Work Harder." It's an honest headline for a player whose underlying numbers are mixed.

The good: the Flames out-shoot opponents at five on five with him on the ice, about 54% of the attempts, and he moves the puck out of his own end well (Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had 71% of his exits leaving with possession last season). His own finishing is right on his expected rate. The less good: Calgary takes only about 47% of the expected goals while he's out there, so the shots aren't the dangerous kind.

The Flames have also scored 5.3 fewer goals than their chances deserve with him on the ice, and our numbers flag that as luck that usually swings back. Evolving-Hockey had him barely above replacement last season, so this is a step forward if it holds. He's playing about 16 minutes a night; we'd watch whether the role grows with the points.
headline: Sharangovich is better than his line
